end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object to keep track without numbers.
Matched marks back to objects to check for missing or extra objects.
Completed both practice attempts correctly without help.
Discussed how spacing can make equal groups look different; by the end, identified five marks in both groups.
end.parentNote: Parth practised using one mark for each object and matching the marks back to check the total. They completed both activities correctly; they first thought a more spread-out line meant more objects, then corrected this by identifying five in each group. At home, you can place the same number of buttons in two rows with different spacing and ask Parth to check by matching one mark to each button.
